specification.problem: Continuous-time quantum walk search on a graph of N vertices with a marked vertex, analyzed via degenerate perturbation theory on a small weighted graph with self-loops. The abstract gives only the method outline, not the specific graph family or the explicit effective Hamiltonian.
specification.reconstruction_scope: Background formulation of CTQW search with H = -gamma L - |w><w| (or adjacency form) and a generic degenerate perturbation theory effective Hamiltonian, illustrated on a tiny assumed instance (complete graph, N=4). The paper's specific diagrammatic rules, graph family, and the subspace of dimension growing with N remain outside the scope.

symbols.meaning: projector onto degenerate eigenspace of H_0
effective Hamiltonian in the degenerate subspace

equations.label: Search Hamiltonian
equations.description: Standard CTQW search Hamiltonian with oracle term on the marked vertex; the paper's exact form (e.g. Laplacian) is not stated in the abstract.
equations.justification: Common form of CTQW search; the abstract mentions only continuous-time search on a graph.
assumptions: Adjacency-matrix form used rather than the Laplacian

equations.label: Evolution
equations.justification: Usual initial state for spatial search by CTQW.

equations.label: Splitting for perturbation theory
equations.description: Split of H into a part with a degenerate eigenspace and a perturbation.
equations.justification: The abstract says the method uses degenerate perturbation theory; the specific H_0, V are not given.
assumptions: The choice of H_0 and V is graph-specific and not given

equations.label: Effective Hamiltonian to second order
equations.description: Standard second-order degenerate perturbation theory effective Hamiltonian. The paper's weighted self-loop graph would encode the entries of this operator, but the mapping rules are not given.
equations.justification: Generic background for the named technique.
assumptions: Valid when ||V|| is small compared with the gap

equations.label: Reduced weighted graph with self-loops
equations.description: Interpretation of H_eff as a small weighted graph with self-loops, with matrix entries as weights.
equations.abstract_quote: sketching small weighted graphs with self-loops and considering degenerate perturbation theory’s effects on them
equations.justification: The abstract links small weighted graphs with self-loops to degenerate perturbation theory; the entries are inferred, not given.
assumptions: Weights correspond to matrix entries of an effective Hamiltonian

registers.name: vertex
registers.role: Basis state |x> labels the graph vertex; computational-basis integer encoding x -> |x>

steps.description: Choose a tiny instance (assumed complete graph K_4, w=0) and build H.
Identify the degenerate subspace and perturbation, and compute H_eff to the chosen order, representing it as a weighted self-loop graph.
Evolve under H for time T and read out the vertex register.

specification.measurement: Computational-basis measurement of the vertex register; success probability |<w|psi(T)>|^2 (assumed).
assumptions: Scope is the generic CTQW search framework with a tiny assumed instance, not the paper's graph family.
Adjacency Hamiltonian with a single marked vertex.
